coordinateSystem: Historical 2015 encounter pole fit, ICRF/J2000; arbitrary display phase
qualification: Weaver et al. (2016) Table 2 historical pole, about 10 degree uncertainty, and 0.4295 day spin. This is not a 2026 pole ephemeris and does not register the Porter 2021 released mesh. Later source fits revise Hydra orientation; retaining this historical axis is an explicit display approximation. No synchronous alignment or absolute prime-meridian claim.
